  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog line 12 sentence "If a required check on it then fails, the PR stays open and nobody gets a Telegram alert, only the run-log warning" is only true at the default alert threshold, because the `pr_auto_merge` message is sent at `ALERT_LEVEL="DEBUG"` (.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1910, only `pr_open` upgrades to WARNING at line 1914) and `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL` (.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:49, default `WARNING`) can be lowered to DEBUG, in which case `_tg_should_send`/`tg_send_msg` (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:83-91 per minimax; scripts/tg_helpers.sh:82-90, 108-120 per openai) delivers it.
  WHY: Operators running with `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=DEBUG` read an alert-behaviour claim that does not match the workflow (a documentation-accuracy defect shipped to consumer repos via `@stable` sync, not a runtime defect); all three flagging reviewers rated it SEVERITY: NIT, mapped here to low, and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this finding and did not adopt it, arguing that no alert about the later check failure exists at any threshold because the only DEBUG message is the end-of-run "Report PR:" link, sent before any check fails.
